name: The Wolf Spring
story: For decades, hunters travelling the Ringed Mountains have told of strange sightings on one of the slopes. Some tell of a giant wolf that walks on two legs, the king of wolves whos breath can uproot trees and houses.
The myth claims the creature watches over a beautiful spring, hidden along the slopes. Those who visit the spring and leave are hunted, those who stay the night are never heard from again.
truth: The spring hides the Prometheus Initiative outpost run by the Alchemist. Anyone who spends the night is kidnapped and used for experimentation.
The 'wolf king' is an escaped failed experiment, it hunts down members of Trinity and tries to scare away passing hunters.
